description: This chart displays the distribution of four categories—N+K+, N−K+, N−K−, and N+K−—across three difficulty levels: easy, medium, and hard, under the CoT (Chain-of-Thought) framework. Each difficulty level is represented by a separate pie chart, and all charts share the same color legend: teal for N+K+, yellow for N−K+, orange for N−K−, and red for N+K−. The easy chart shows four slices: teal (N+K+) at 40.6%, yellow (N−K+) at 45.9%, orange (N−K−) at 10.1%, and red (N+K−) at 3.3%. The medium chart also has four slices: teal (N+K+) at 44.6%, yellow (N−K+) at 44.3%, orange (N−K−) at 7.2%, and red (N+K−) at 3.9%. The hard chart displays four slices: yellow (N−K+) at 36.2%, teal (N+K+) at 20.1%, orange (N−K−) at 7.0%, and red (N+K−) at a value obscured by a gray rectangle, preventing its percentage from being read. All pie charts have percentage values labeled directly inside their respective slices, and none of the slices are visually emphasized or exploded. The slices within each pie chart appear to be ordered in descending size from left to right.
